claims.text: The TDV account distinguishes an Ottoman appointment from Ali Haydar’s inability to enter Mecca. Cairo’s ministerial relationship is separately recorded. Blake reports Egypt’s British protectorate; Lansing later explains qualified US recognition. Appointment, ministerial office, reported protectorate and conditional recognition do not establish identical control, popular consent or one simultaneous wartime transition.
